copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 机器人渠道：复制并注册 Discord 适配器、安装依赖、跑构建和注册测试，再引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，重启服务后就能在私信或服务器频道里跟它对话。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人渠道时；处在 /setup 流程中，或使用 /manage-channels、/init-first-agent 时也会用到。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 机器人频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token，帮我配好
say.note: 校验 token、写入 .env 并重启服务

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 私信频道接入并连到助理
say.note: 会打开私信并回读频道 id

howto.what_en: Adds a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs its package, builds it, then guides you through creating a bot, pasting the Bot Token and restarting the service to chat over DMs or channels.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, or while running /setup, /manage-channels or /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package and runs the test

say_en.text: Here's my Discord Bot Token — set it up
say_en.note: Validates the token, stores it, restarts the service

say_en.text: Wire up my Discord DM channel to the agent
say_en.note: Opens the DM and captures the channel id
